name: web-blue-square-tile-gradient-from-white-to-navy
title: Grid of flat blue squares shading from white at top left to deep navy at bottom right
whatItIs: A rectangle of uniform square tiles whose blue tones shift diagonally from near white to deep navy, with slight tile-to-tile variation.
whatItMeans: Cool and digital; the tile mosaic reads as a pixelated sky-to-ocean gradient.
techniques: Build a gradient from equal squares.
Use as a background or divider.

vocabulary.definition: Slight differences in tone between tiles.
A gradient running corner to corner.
A gradient rendered with blocky pixels.
